about.title: About
about.description: Learn about FCL Download Site - a community-built public download site for Minecraft Java Edition Android launchers and resources. View site background, contributors, download line providers, and open source projects used.
about.ogDescription: Learn about the background, contributors, and open source projects of FCL Download Site.
about.aboutP1: Minecraft, as a sandbox game with high freedom, has an extremely large player ecosystem. From launchers, modpacks, and shader packs to world saves, gameplay videos, and tutorials - the community's creations are diverse. However, the largest group remains ordinary players. The other side of high freedom is that it directly or indirectly raises the entry barrier. We hope to do our best to help ordinary players avoid detours and focus more on the game itself.
about.aboutP2: With the improvement of mobile phone performance, more and more people want to play Minecraft: Java Edition on Android devices. In this context, various developers have contributed out of passion, resulting in many open-source and free launcher projects.
about.aboutP3: Fold Craft Launcher Download Site is a non-profit unofficial download site. We sincerely thank every developer and every player who supports us.
about.aboutP4: XiaoluoFoxington, as the site owner, maintains this site and provides Line 1 download source. Developers like Wanmeng have also contributed to this site. Haha252 and others have provided additional download lines that greatly relieve traffic pressure. Ningmei provided the domain name for this site. In addition, we are grateful to all the enthusiastic friends for their sponsorship, support, and encouragement!
about.aboutP5: We stand on the shoulders of giants. Compared to this site, the launcher and software developers behind it have it even harder - they have invested more time and energy, and most have chosen to open source everything without reservation. Their spirit of selfless dedication and open sharing deserves to be praised and learned by everyone. Thank you again for their contributions!
about.aboutP6: This site is not the official Minecraft website, nor the official website of any launcher. It has no affiliation with Mojang, Microsoft, or any launcher developers. This site is solely a public-interest resource aggregation and sharing website, aiming to provide convenient download services for ordinary players.
about.aiP1: This site used AI assistance during development, including some code, documentation, and images.
about.aiP2: We treat AI as a tool rather than a worker, and will not let AI take full responsibility for the site's operation and maintenance.
